senses.gloss: m. (cmp. Assyr. zabâlu, KAT2, p. 550; cmp. צָבַר) [heaped up,] esp. foliage piled up for forming manure, manure, deposits.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 4:1">Sabb. IV, 1</cite> you must not keep dishes warm for the Sabbath <he>בז׳ וכ׳</he> in foliage … whether dry or moist.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:8">Ab. Zar. III, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 48b:11">48ᵇ</cite>) <he>והוָֹה להן לז׳</he> and serves for them as manure.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:6">Yoma V, 6</cite> <he>נמכרין … לז׳</he> is sold to the gardeners for forming manure.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 11:8">Tosef. B. Mets. XI, 8</cite> <he>זִיבְלוֹ</he> his heaped-up foliage.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:7">B. Mets. V, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 72b:8">72ᵇ</cite>) <he>עד שיהיה לו ז׳ באשפתו</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>אלא א״כ היתה וכ׳</he>) unless he has manure piled up; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זְבָלִים</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 3:1">Shebi. III, 1</cite> <he>מאימתי מוציאין ז׳ וכ׳</he> when may deposits of foliage be carried out for piling up in the fields.—
Gen. R. s. 31 לז׳ (Snh. 108ᵇ sing.) for deposits of excrements &c.—Tosef. B. Mets. l. c. שעת הז׳ the season for carrying out foliage; a. fr.—בית הז׳ a field dependent on manuring.
